findings.claim: The G8 implementation tree contains executable parser/projection, proof, routing, replay, fuzz/test and directcode machinery. The inspected machine_language.py is an r4/IR-0.9 predecessor component inside the G8 lineage and implements deterministic compact codecs over a canonical content-addressed store, integrity checks, critical proof validation and authority-origin gating.
findings.implication: Do not redesign parser/canonical-store/envelope/proof concepts from zero; port useful invariants into the frozen ClayCode semantics while preserving current authority rules and testing against current counterexamples.

findings.claim: G8's folder named compiler points to a bounded directcode add4 equivalence C path. Historical artifacts show GCC and Clang returncode 0; final_checks reports 11 pytest passes, 4 candidates x 256 proof cases and 10,000 control mutations. Current-session GCC/Clang recompilation and execution also passed.
findings.negative_constraint: This must not be counted as a general-purpose ClayCode compiler. BASE GENERAL_PURPOSE_GATE remains open and still requires CLI/HTTP/DB/concurrency/GUI/compiler/GPU/system-effect/FRANK proofs.
findings.implication: Reuse equivalence-class generation, multi-backend translation validation and proof-kernel patterns as compiler-lowering scaffolding.

findings.claim: G9 reports zero deterministic disagreement between full-GRF and an information-equivalent causal-state-machine baseline; GRF labels themselves added no measured effect in that proxy. Explicit admissibility/guards mattered, not metaphysical naming.
findings.implication: Preserve executable causal/admissibility semantics; do not add mandatory wire syntax merely to encode framework labels without an executable counterexample or measured gain.

findings.claim: G9 reports parse(render(AST)) equivalence on 2000/2000 transport cases but failure to catch semantically manipulated values; counterfactual/invariance binding detected 1000/1000 constructed semantic manipulations.
findings.implication: Roundtrip/hash tests prove transport integrity, not semantic equivalence. H1/H2/H3 must add invariant and intervention/counterfactual equivalence tests.

findings.claim: G9 reports 18,000 train-ready transitions split 12k/3k/3k train/validation/OOD; in a reversed-surface-correlation OOD split a surface-only proxy scored balanced accuracy 0.112 while the causal-state-machine and semantically identical GRF representation scored 1.000.
findings.implication: Treat the 18k corpus as an audit candidate, not accepted training data: verify generation ancestry, leakage, semantic equivalence and relevance to the frozen Clay representation before ingestion.

findings.claim: The 800 x 4B swarm document is a factorial experimental design, not an executed 800-independent-agent result. It explicitly warns that 800 logical agents over one checkpoint are not 800 independent samples and proposes pod/cell analysis, effective-sample-size accounting, matched XENO-vs-key=value controls and recurrent-workspace/grounded-state/XENO interaction tests.
findings.implication: Route as future experiment design; award no empirical completion credit until executed with frozen seeds/holds and proper unit-of-analysis.

findings.claim: Digital Retina has a real multi-file CPU vision implementation. retina/core.py exposes structured analysis with description, concepts, objects, OCR, faces, logos, image metadata and elapsed_ms; retina/vision includes frank_eye.py, CLIP, OCR, region/scene/composition and pattern modules. A smoke test requires structured output fields and real model weights/sample image.
findings.implication: Build the mandatory Clay VisualPercept adapter around this structured substrate instead of reducing vision to a caption-only interface. Current frozen target must preserve provenance/uncertainty and causal-use tracing.

findings.claim: The Digital Retina working paper reports 82.4% held-out phrase coverage on 47 unseen images / 1,196 phrases, 1.5-2.0 s/image on 4-vCPU CPU-only hardware, and at threshold 0.22 a realistic-negative false-positive rate of 13.6%. It explicitly labels itself non-peer-reviewed, n=1 engineering work and notes limited distribution/compositional-binding coverage.
findings.implication: Use as historical baseline and benchmark scaffold, not a frozen acceptance threshold. Reproduce on current project hardware and add compositional/stale/replay/adversarial visual tests.

findings.claim: The autonomous vision training design proposes event-triggered visual curiosity rather than periodic capture, with cooldown, daily budget, no-look examples, context-change/post-action triggers and habituation under repeated OCR similarity.
findings.implication: Use as a candidate visual attention policy and adversarial fixture; do not claim it was deployed merely from the design document.

findings.claim: FRANK v26.1 training instructions document repeated failures from runtime/training-format mismatch and explicitly separate architecture/code truth, runtime prompt state and LoRA behavior. They also require tool-result role compatibility and runtime-shaped state blocks.
findings.implication: Final Clay training corpus must carry schema-versioned runtime-equivalent contexts and must not bake mutable live facts into target behavior. User-specific historical content is superseded and is not transferred.
